question: How many silos were in the group with the lower pH, and what acetic acid concentration did that group have?
rendered:
According to the document, 49 silos were classified as the relatively well-fermented group (LPGood), which had a lower pH. This is the group with the lower pH. 

The acetic acid concentration in the LPGood group was 11.27 g/kg DM.
